# orbivisor_access_role (Resource)

A custom access role (a set of privileges).

Manifest kind `AccessRole`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `privileges` (List of String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
